summary: Watch default list ordering becomes Random. New/default non-search visits generate a fresh shuffle seed; pagination and filter links preserve that seed so page traversal stays stable without duplicates caused by reshuffling. Search still defaults to relevance. Explicit non-random sorts clear stale shuffle state. Poster Shelf, filters, Shared Shell, Navigation and frozen Channels remain unchanged. No data model, schema, migration or updater change. Production remains Owner manual.
